about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Fermented Red Jalapeno Hot Sauce
recipes.summary: A tangy, lightly funky hot sauce made from salt-brined red jalapenos fermented for a week and blended with vinegar.
steps: Dissolve the salt in the water to make a brine.
Pack the jalapenos, garlic and carrot into a clean jar and pour over the brine, keeping everything submerged under a weight.
Cover loosely and ferment at room temperature for 7 days, until bubbly and pleasantly sour, releasing the gas daily.
Drain, keeping the brine, and blend the solids with the vinegar, honey and 100ml of the brine for 2 minutes, until smooth.
Simmer the sauce for 5 minutes, then cool and bottle.
notes: Keeps 3 months in the fridge.
Wear gloves when chopping chillies.

recipes.title: Fermented Habanero and Carrot Hot Sauce
recipes.summary: A fruity, fiery Caribbean-style hot sauce built on fermented habaneros, carrot and lime.
steps: Dissolve the salt in the water.
Pack the chillies, carrots, onion and garlic into a jar, cover with the brine and weigh down.
Ferment at room temperature for 7 days, until bubbly and sour, opening the lid daily to release the gas.
Drain and blend the solids with the lime juice, vinegar, sugar and 100ml of the brine for 2 minutes, until silky.
Simmer for 5 minutes, then cool and bottle.
notes: Very hot: use 100g habanero for a medium sauce.
Keeps 3 months in the fridge.

recipes.title: Louisiana-Style Vinegar Hot Sauce
recipes.summary: A thin, sharp, pourable hot sauce of red chilli, garlic and vinegar for eggs, wings, beans and fried food.
steps: Simmer the chillies, garlic, water and half the vinegar for 15 minutes, until the chillies are very soft.
Blend with the salt, sugar and remaining vinegar for 2 minutes, until completely smooth.
Strain through a sieve, pressing well, then bottle.
Rest for 3 days in the fridge before using, until the flavours mellow.
notes: Keeps 3 months in the fridge.
Wear gloves and open a window while simmering the chillies.

recipes.title: Kuwaiti Daqoos Tomato and Chilli Sauce
recipes.summary: A tangy Gulf tomato sauce with garlic, cumin, coriander and chilli, served with grilled meat, rice and flatbread.
steps: Heat the oil in a pan and cook the garlic and chillies for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes, cumin, coriander and salt and simmer for 15 minutes, until the sauce is thick and the oil separates.
Stir in the vinegar and lemon juice and cook for 2 minutes.
Cool slightly, then stir through the chopped coriander.
notes: Serve warm or cold; it keeps 5 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Brown Butter and Sage Pan Sauce
recipes.summary: Nutty brown butter with crisp sage and lemon, spooned over pasta, gnocchi, roast pumpkin or fish.
steps: Melt the butter in a light-coloured pan over medium heat.
Cook for 4 minutes, until the milk solids turn golden brown and smell nutty.
Add the sage and garlic and cook for 1 minute, until the sage is crisp and the garlic pale gold.
Remove from the heat and add the lemon juice, which will spit, then season with the salt and pepper.
notes: Use immediately while it is hot and frothy.

recipes.title: Red Wine and Shallot Pan Sauce
recipes.summary: A glossy steak sauce of shallots reduced with red wine, stock and thyme, enriched with cold butter.
steps: Cook the shallots in the first measure of butter for 5 minutes, until soft and golden.
Add the wine and thyme and boil for 8 minutes, until reduced by two thirds.
Add the stock and boil for 8 minutes, until syrupy enough to coat a spoon.
Remove the thyme, whisk in the vinegar and the cold butter a cube at a time, until glossy.
Season with the pepper and serve straight away.
notes: Do not boil once the butter is in, or the sauce splits.

recipes.title: Onion Gravy with Thyme
recipes.summary: Slowly browned onions simmered in rich stock with thyme and a splash of balsamic, ideal for sausages and mash.
steps: Cook the onions in the butter and oil over medium-low heat for 25 minutes, stirring often, until deeply golden and sweet.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute.
Gradually add the stock, stirring, then add the vinegar, worcestershire sauce and thyme.
Simmer for 10 minutes, until glossy and thickened enough to coat a spoon.
Remove the thyme, season with the pepper and serve hot.
notes: Use vegetable stock and omit the worcestershire sauce for a vegetarian gravy.

recipes.title: Peppercorn Cream Pan Sauce
recipes.summary: A classic steak-house sauce of cracked peppercorns, brandy, stock and cream.
steps: Cook the shallots and peppercorns in the butter for 3 minutes, until soft.
Carefully add the brandy and let it bubble for 1 minute, until almost evaporated.
Add the stock and boil for 5 minutes, until reduced by half.
Stir in the cream and mustard and simmer for 3 minutes, until it coats the back of a spoon.
Season with the salt and taste, adding more pepper if you like.
notes: Keep the heat low once the cream is in, or it will split.

recipes.title: Mustard and Tarragon Cream Sauce
recipes.summary: A tangy, herby cream sauce with Dijon, white wine and tarragon for chicken, fish and vegetables.
steps: Cook the shallots in the butter for 3 minutes, until soft.
Add the wine and boil for 4 minutes, until reduced by two thirds.
Add the stock and cream and simmer for 5 minutes, until thick enough to coat a spoon.
Whisk in the mustard, tarragon, lemon juice and salt and warm through without boiling.
notes: Swap the tarragon for dill for fish.

recipes.title: Carolina Mustard BBQ Sauce
recipes.summary: A thin, tangy South Carolina sauce of yellow mustard, cider vinegar and brown sugar for pulled pork and sausages.
steps: Whisk everything together in a saucepan.
Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 15 minutes, stirring often, until slightly thickened and glossy.
Cool completely, then pour into a clean jar and store in the fridge.
notes: Keeps 3 weeks in the fridge.
Add a dash of hot sauce for more heat.

recipes.title: Cumin Roast Cauliflower on Pomegranate Tahini
recipes.summary: Deeply golden cauliflower florets drizzled with lemony tahini and scattered with pomegranate and parsley.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C and line a large tray with baking paper.
Toss the cauliflower with the oil, cumin and salt on a large tray.
Roast for 30 minutes, turning once, until deeply golden and tender.
Whisk the tahini, lemon juice, garlic and water until smooth and pourable.
Spread the tahini on a platter, pile the cauliflower on top and scatter with pomegranate and parsley.
notes: Sumac makes a good extra garnish.

recipes.title: Honey Roasted Carrots with Hazelnut Spice Crunch
recipes.summary: Sweet roasted carrots glazed with honey and dusted with a crunchy nut and spice dukkah, served over yoghurt.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C and line a large tray with baking paper.
Toss the carrots with the oil, honey and salt on a lined tray.
Roast for 30 minutes, turning once, until tender and caramelised at the edges.
Toast the hazelnuts and sesame in a dry pan for 3 minutes, until golden, then stir through the cumin and coriander.
Stir the lemon juice into the yoghurt and spread on a platter.
Pile the carrots on top and scatter with the toasted nut mix and mint.
notes: Use maple syrup instead of honey for a vegan side with dairy-free yoghurt.

recipes.title: Roast Broccoli with Garlic and Chilli
recipes.summary: Charred broccoli florets roasted hot with garlic and chilli flakes, finished with lemon and toasted almonds.
steps: Heat the oven to 230°C and line a large tray with baking paper.
Toss the broccoli with the oil, garlic, chilli flakes and salt on a large tray.
Roast for 18 minutes, turning once, until the tips are charred and the stems tender.
Toast the almonds in a dry pan for 3 minutes, until golden.
Finish with the lemon zest, juice and almonds.
notes: Swap the almonds for toasted breadcrumbs.

recipes.title: Maple Roast Pumpkin Wedges with Sage
recipes.summary: Sweet roasted pumpkin wedges glazed with maple, brown butter and crisp sage.

items: 1 kg pumpkin, cut into wedges with skin on

steps: Heat the oven to 210°C and line a large tray with baking paper.
Toss the pumpkin with the oil, 2 tbsp maple syrup and the salt on a lined tray.
Roast for 35 minutes, turning once, until caramelised and tender.
Melt the butter in a pan until foaming, add the sage and cook for 1 minute, until crisp.
Pour over the pumpkin with the remaining maple syrup, pecans and pepper.
notes: Leave the skin on, it is edible and holds the wedges together.

recipes.title: Crispy Smashed Potatoes with Rosemary
recipes.summary: Boiled baby potatoes smashed flat and roasted until the edges are shatteringly crisp, with rosemary and garlic.
steps: Boil the potatoes in well-salted water for 20 minutes, until a knife slides in easily, then drain well.
Heat the oven to 230°C and heat the oil on a large tray.
Space the potatoes on the tray and smash each flat with a glass.
Scatter over the rosemary, garlic and salt.
Roast for 30 minutes, turning once, until deep golden and crisp.
notes: Dry the boiled potatoes well so they crisp.

recipes.title: Roasted Beetroot with Yoghurt and Dill
recipes.summary: Earthy roast beetroot wedges on garlicky yoghurt with dill, walnuts and a little lemon.

items: 800g beetroot, scrubbed and cut into wedges

steps: Heat the oven to 200°C and line a large tray with baking paper.
Toss the beetroot with the oil and salt on a lined tray and cover loosely with foil.
Roast for 40 minutes, then uncover and roast for 10 minutes, until tender and slightly caramelised.
Mix the yoghurt, garlic and half the lemon juice and spread on a plate.
Pile the beetroot on top and finish with the dill, walnuts and remaining lemon.
notes: Wear gloves to avoid staining your hands.

recipes.title: Oven-Roasted Cherry Tomatoes with Thyme
recipes.summary: Slowly roasted cherry tomatoes concentrated with thyme and garlic, to spoon over toast, pasta or grilled meat.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C and line a large tray with baking paper.
Toss the tomatoes with the oil, garlic, thyme, sugar, salt and pepper in a baking dish.
Roast for 35 minutes, until the skins burst and the tomatoes are jammy and slightly caramelised.
Squash the garlic into the juices and serve warm.
notes: Keeps 5 days covered in the fridge.

recipes.title: Chinese-Style Sesame Cabbage Slaw
recipes.summary: Crunchy shredded cabbage and carrot in a nutty sesame, soy and rice vinegar dressing.
steps: Toast the sesame seeds in a dry pan for 2 minutes, until golden.
Whisk the soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, honey and ginger together.
Toss the cabbage, carrots, spring onions and coriander with the dressing.
Scatter over the sesame seeds and serve straight away.
notes: Add roasted peanuts or crispy noodles for extra crunch.

recipes.title: Apple and Celery Slaw with Mustard Dressing
recipes.summary: A crisp, tangy slaw of matchstick apple, celery and red cabbage in a mustard and yoghurt dressing.
steps: Whisk the yoghurt, mayonnaise, mustard, vinegar, honey and salt together.
Toss the apples, celery and cabbage in the dressing until evenly coated.
Scatter with the walnuts and eat within 30 minutes, while crisp.
notes: Squeeze lemon over the apple to stop browning.

recipes.title: Pearl Couscous Salad with Roasted Vegetables
recipes.summary: Chewy pearl couscous tossed with roasted capsicum, zucchini and red onion, with a lemon and herb dressing.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C and line a large tray with baking paper.
Toss the vegetables with 1 tbsp oil, the cumin and salt on a tray and roast for 25 minutes, until tender and charred at the edges.
Boil the couscous in salted water for 8 minutes, until tender but chewy, then drain.
Toss the warm couscous with the remaining oil, lemon juice, herbs and vegetables.
Crumble the feta over the top and serve warm or at room temperature.
notes: Leave out the feta for a vegan salad.

recipes.title: Barley and Roast Pumpkin Salad
recipes.summary: Nutty pearl barley with roast pumpkin, spinach and pepitas in a maple and mustard dressing.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C and line a large tray with baking paper.
Toss the pumpkin with 1 tbsp oil and the salt on a tray and roast for 30 minutes, until golden and tender.
Simmer the barley in plenty of water for 30 minutes, until tender, then drain.
Whisk the remaining oil, mustard, maple syrup and vinegar.
Toss the warm barley, pumpkin, onion and dressing, then fold through the spinach and pepitas.
notes: Good warm or cold the next day.

recipes.title: Wild Rice, Orange and Pecan Salad
recipes.summary: Chewy wild rice mix with orange segments, pecans and herbs in a citrus vinaigrette.
steps: Simmer the rice in plenty of salted water for 35 minutes, until the grains split, then drain well.
Toast the pecans in a dry pan for 3 minutes, until fragrant.
Whisk the reserved orange juice, oil, vinegar, mustard and salt.
Toss the warm rice with the dressing, then fold in the orange segments, pecans, parsley and spring onion.
notes: Serve at room temperature.

recipes.title: Pacific Sweet Potato Wedges with Coconut Lime Dip
recipes.summary: Oven-roasted sweet potato wedges served with a cool coconut yoghurt, lime and chilli dip.

items: 1 kg sweet potatoes, cut into wedges

steps: Heat the oven to 220°C and line a large tray with baking paper.
Toss the sweet potato with the oil, salt and paprika on a large tray.
Roast for 30 minutes, turning once, until golden and tender inside.
Mix the coconut yoghurt with the lime zest, juice, chilli and half the coriander.
Serve the wedges with the dip and the remaining coriander.
notes: Use ordinary oil if you dislike the coconut flavour.

recipes.title: Pacific Coconut Pumpkin and Cabbage Soup
recipes.summary: A gentle coconut milk soup of pumpkin, cabbage and ginger with lime, inspired by island home cooking.
steps: Cook the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil for 5 minutes, until soft.
Add the pumpkin, stock and coconut milk and simmer for 15 minutes, until the pumpkin is tender.
Add the cabbage and simmer for 5 minutes, until just wilted.
Season with the lime juice and salt.
Scatter with the coriander.
notes: Mash some of the pumpkin for a thicker soup.

recipes.title: Iraqi Shorbat Rizz Rice and Lemon Soup
recipes.summary: A comforting rice, lentil and lemon soup with turmeric, cumin and a drizzle of olive oil.
steps: Cook the onion and garlic in half the oil for 5 minutes, until soft.
Stir in the turmeric and cumin for 1 minute.
Add the rice, lentils and stock and simmer for 22 minutes, until both are very soft and the soup thick.
Stir in the lemon juice and salt.
Serve with the parsley and a drizzle of oil.
notes: Thin with a splash of water when reheating.
